INHERITS pains 1-8 from the first pass (evidence/define_actual-1.json, superseded) unchanged: the lane cannot open the design document or v1; the agent vouches for its own conformance in prose; guidance does not reach the agent it binds; the most-used tool applies one edit per call; search answers the wrong question confidently and cannot see the record; the fence is enforced on the honest path and open on the other; the machine-local config has no lane; the record depends on a name anyone can delete.

THREE PAINS ARE ADDED, all found by the rewalk, all with witnesses from today.

PAIN 9 - THE REVIEW HAS NEVER HAPPENED. se.meth-gate-review declares five standard fields REQUIRED on every gate: verify_round, validate_round, redteam_round, state_of_the_art, verdict. Its own text explains why nobody notices: 'The compiler will inject the standard fields into every gate's form (single source); until then, fill them from here.' Nothing ever injected them and nothing ever asked, so across every gate of every iteration in this project's history, NOT ONE has been filled. WITNESS: the owner, 2026-07-25 - 'why is there a requirement, and then you violate it and nobody sees that? Is it not part of the review for the gate prototype? Did you send the red team? Did you steelman the opposite?' The honest answer was that the rounds exist, are required, and have never been run.

PAIN 10 - A REQUIREMENT CAN BE RETIRED BY AN ADR THAT SOUNDS LIKE ARCHITECTURE. R3 says a search returns matches WITH a caller-specified number of surrounding lines. The first pass chose a provider that cannot return fields and context in one call, and then minted se.adr-locate-and-read-are-separate to explain that context belongs in a separate read. The ADR reads as principle; it exists because the tool cannot do the thing. The tests were then written against the DESIGN rather than the REGISTER, so the suite went green with no context test in it at all. WITNESS: the owner found it in one reading - 'I feel like you don't respect your own requirements strongly enough.' Nothing in the machine did.

PAIN 11 - A GATE CAN VOTE TO REOPEN AND NOTHING HAPPENS. 'Reopen with named states' is specified in twelve ledger nodes - the gate review's verdict, fold_back's ripple, the refine track, the suspect model. The word 'reopen' appeared ZERO times in the entire engine. WITNESS: measured at i12 during this rewalk, and it blocked the owner's own instruction to rewalk the iteration until the mechanism was built. A verdict the machine cannot carry out is a synonym for carrying on.
